normalizer.quotient: C6; its action on the basic invariant ring factors through C2

theorem: The setwise stabilizer of the parabolic slice has order 3888 = 648*6; modulo pointwise G25 it is C6, and its action on the basic invariant ring factors through parity C2. Its nontrivial quotient fixes u6 and w12 and negates v9. The characteristic-zero reflecting arrangement restricts as one slice factor, twelve parabolic factors once, and nine extra factors cubed.
